title: NETBCI2026: NETBCI: longitudinal right-hand motor imagery vs rest BCI training
description: A longitudinal EEG dataset of right-hand motor imagery versus rest brain-computer interface (BCI) training. 19 healthy right-handed participants completed 4 sessions on separate days, each with 6 online feedback runs. Participants controlled a one-dimensional cursor in a two-target box task, with visual feedback. The dataset contains 74-channel EEG recorded alongside MEG and comprises 14,431 labelled trials. It supports studies of learning and neurofeedback in BCI training.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a 74-channel Easycap passive Ag/AgCl cap, amplified by a MEGIN TRIUX system, at 250 Hz. The reference was the mastoids and the ground the left scapula. Stimulus presentation and online feedback were run in BCI2000. Each trial had a 1 s inter-stimulus interval followed by 5 s of target presentation, with cursor feedback from 3 to 6 s. The up target was sustained right-hand grasping motor imagery and the down target was rest. Each run had 32 trials in the protocol.
